basic_details.short_information: Steel Authority of India Bhilai Steel Plant (SAIL BSP) has published the Consultant Doctors (Specialist / GDMO) Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.sail.co.in. The recruitment drive aims to fill 7 Consultant Doctors (Specialist / GDMO) positions on a contractual basis. Candidates not exceeding 69 years of age and possessing MBBS with a PG Diploma or PG Degree in the relevant specialty are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 19 August 2026. Candidates can easily access the official notification and walk-in details through the links provided below.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SAIL BSP Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization recruiting for?
faq.answer: The Steel Authority of India Bhilai Steel Plant (SAIL BSP) is recruiting for Consultant Doctors (Specialist / GDMO) posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the available posts?
faq.answer: Posts include General Medicine, Skin, OB&G, ENT, and General Duty Medical Officers (GDMOs).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for Consultant Doctors (Specialist / GDMO) positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for SAIL BSP Consultant Doctors is scheduled for 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Consultant Doctors (Specialist / GDMO) posts is 69 years.

faq.question: Q7. What are the required qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree, with PG Diploma or PG Degree in the relevant speciality for Consultant Doctors, and MBBS for GDMOs.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for the Consultant Doctors?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 90,000 to Rs. 1,80,000 per month, depending on the post and qualification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee for the SAIL BSP recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a personal Interview.
